themes.name: EV adoption in India
themes.thesis: Rising electric-vehicle penetration (FAME-II from Apr-2019, PLI-ACC, PM E-DRIVE) shifts auto value from engines and lubricants to batteries, power electronics, copper/aluminium and charging.

themes.name: AI compute & data-centre build-out
themes.thesis: Generative AI drives data-centre capacity: power, transformers, switchgear, cables and cooling are the picks-and-shovels; labour-based IT services and seat-based software face price deflation.

themes.name: Solar & renewable capacity build-out
themes.thesis: India's 500 GW non-fossil target: modules and EPC are visible; solar glass, silver paste and transmission conductors are the less-visible inputs.

themes.name: IPL & home cricket consumption
themes.thesis: During the IPL (and home World Cups) at-home viewing lifts delivery food, beverages and alcobev; multiplex footfalls suffer.

themes.name: Travel & tourism demand
themes.thesis: Domestic and outbound travel growth (and event travel such as FIFA / ICC tournaments) lifts airlines, hotels and booking platforms; luggage makers are a less-watched second-order beneficiary.

themes.name: Diwali festive demand
themes.thesis: Festive-season purchases (autos, gold jewellery, durables, apparel) concentrate in the weeks before Diwali; e-commerce logistics and card issuers carry the less-visible volume.

themes.name: Monsoon & rural demand
themes.thesis: A timely, normal monsoon lifts kharif sowing: fertilisers, agrochemicals, seeds and tractors first, then rural consumption; pumps and PVC pipes are the less-visible irrigation plays.

themes.name: Summer & heatwaves
themes.thesis: Hot summers lift room-AC, cooler and fan sales, beverages and ice cream, and power-exchange prices; AC contract manufacturers are the less-visible play.

themes.name: Crude-oil price spike
themes.thesis: Higher crude helps upstream producers and hurts crude-derivative consumers: oil marketers, paints, tyres and airlines.

themes.name: RBI easing cycle
themes.thesis: Policy-rate cuts lower funding costs for NBFCs and housing finance, revive housing demand and - one step removed - building materials (pipes, tiles, plywood, cement).

themes.name: Defence indigenisation
themes.thesis: Positive indigenisation lists (from 2020) and rising capital outlay move orders to domestic primes; special alloys, electronics sub-systems and simulators are the second-order suppliers.

themes.name: Railway modernisation capex
themes.thesis: Record railway capex (wagons, Vande Bharat, Kavach, station redevelopment) flows to EPC, wagon makers and less-visible suppliers of signalling and forged wheels.

themes.name: Electronics manufacturing (China+1, PLI)
themes.thesis: PLI schemes and China+1 sourcing move phone, IT-hardware and component assembly to India: EMS makers first, then OSAT / semiconductor packaging.

themes.name: Gold price rally
themes.thesis: Higher gold prices raise collateral values for gold-loan NBFCs (more lending per gram, lower LTV risk); jewellers gain on inventory but lose volumes.

themes.name: Mobile data & 5G roll-out
themes.thesis: 5G roll-out and data growth lift telecom tariffs; optical fibre and telecom-equipment makers are the less-visible beneficiaries of densification.

themes.name: Government infrastructure capex
themes.thesis: Roads, water (Jal Jeevan) and urban infrastructure spending lifts EPC, cement and steel; explosives, construction cranes and water pipes are the less-visible plays.
